I have the orders list. Now I need to get net balance for each customer: acme (170), cobalt (172), birch (175). Let me call net_balance for each customer.
I have net balance for acme (11259). Now I need net balance for cobalt (customer from order 172).
I have net balance for cobalt (54502). Now I need net balance for birch (customer from order 175).
I have net balances for all customers: acme 11259, cobalt 54502, birch 18633. Now I need to record payouts for each customer.
Payout for acme recorded successfully. Now I need to record payouts for cobalt and birch.
I made a typo in the tool name. It should be 'record_payout' without the space.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_ cents'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: I need to fix the argument name from 'amount_ cents' to 'amount_cents'.
